8 made as of December1S 2011, by and among by and between Jupiter 21 LLC, having an address at 150 Myrtle Avenue, Suite 2,Brooklyn,New York 11201 (the “Purchaser") and 7 Second Avenue Housing Development Fund Corporation, having an address at 7 Second Avenue, New York, New York 10005 (the “Seller"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Seller is the owner in fee title of a parcel of land in NewYork,New York, known as and by the street address 7 Second Avenue, New York,New York,designated as Block 456,Lot 29 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County,and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “"Seller Land"; the improvements currently existing thereupon as of the date hereof, the “Seller Building” and, the Seller Land and the Seller Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “"Seller Property"); and WHEREAS,Purchaser istheowner offeetitlein certainland,inNewYork,NewYork,known as and by the street addresses 9 and 11-17 Second Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Block 456,Lots 27 and 28on the Tax Map of the City of New York,New York County,and more particularly described inExhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof(said land and tax lots being hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Purchaser Land” and, together with any building or improvements placed thereon hereinafter referred to as, the “Purchaser Property"; the Seller Land and the Purchaser Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); and WHEREAS,thePurchaser intends toconstruct a newbuilding of approximately70,000 square feet in the aggregate, which shall consist of approximately 65 apartments units and approximately 6,000 gross square feet of ground floor commercial space (the “Project") ; and WHEREAS,the Project will contain more floor area than is now available for use under the floor area ratio limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution") as it relates to the Purchaser Land as an independent zoning lot, with the result that Purchaser and Seller desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for declaring the Purchaser Land and the Seller Land a single zoning lot for the purpose of causing the Project to comply with the limitations contained in the Zoning Resolution.
